text:
Maya: Alright crew — draft day energy. Who's in for a silly jersey side-bet for tomorrow's watch? Loser buys nachos for the office watch party :taco:
Kevin: I'm in. Loser has to wear the opposing team's cap for the whole afternoon :smile:
Ash: Wait — is this a fantasy draft bet or just the big game? I'm 50/50.
Maya: Big game + mock draft after. Winner gets to pick the playlist. Loser = nachos + team cap.
Raj: @Kevin @Ash I'm down too. Putting my official stake: a coffee run + one dozen cookies.
Sophie: I will participate but only if DJ rights are really on the line. No backsliding.
Oliver: I refuse to be held hostage by playlist tyranny. If I lose I bring bagels instead.
Em: LOL can we make the loser also change their Slack avatar to the winning team for 24h? :joy:
Kevin: Deal. Avatar swap is cruel but necessary.
Maya: Sounds good. Quick rules: 1) Must show proof (photo) to #random. 2) Nachos/bagels/cookies ordered by 11am Monday if applicable. 3) Avatar change lasts 24 hours starting at 6pm Monday.
Ash: Cool. Also, can we do a tiny poll for chips preference? Just to avoid chaos if I'm the nacho-bringer.
Raj: Chips poll = mandatory. I vote: kettle-cooked all the way.
Sophie: I like some spicy salsa options. Vote: :thumbsup: plain :thumbsdown: spicy
Kevin: :thumbsup: for plain? I'm split.
snack-bot: Reminder — snack sign-up form: https://forms.redwood/snack-signup. Please fill by EOD.
Maya: @snack-bot thanks. Also: small fun twist — whoever gets the worst fantasy pick (most points below expected) has to lead a 30s halftime meme slideshow.
Oliver: Ugh that's targeted at me, my draft strategy is chaos.
Em: Can we add a consolation prize for the runner-up? Chocolate?
Sophie: Runner-up gets to skip the first round of snack duty next event.
Raj: Fine. I'm officially terrified and excited. Good luck everyone.
Kevin: May the best (or most strategic) playlist win.
Maya: Alright, locking this thread. Everyone fill the snack form and DM me any special dietary stuff. See you at the watch party :popcorn:
